```{r}
mk<-read_csv("meta/full-meta.csv")  %>% mutate(Path2=ifelse(Dedup > 2e6, paste0("data/downsample/",Ind,".reduced.bam"),
                     Path)) %>% mutate(Taxon=Species) %>% filter(Species %in% c("obesus","snyderi","toikona"))

m2k<-mk  %>% filter(Dedup > 2e5)


m2k %>% select(Path) %>% write_csv("bamlists/m2k.bamlist", col_names = FALSE)
m2k %>% select(Path2) %>% write_csv("bamlists/m2k-downsample.bamlist", col_names = FALSE)
```
